shell.buildStamp: UI build: {{time}} — if this date is old or missing, your browser is serving a cached bundle; hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R), use a private window, or launch the app from the Start menu instead of localhost.

wrongLaunch.title: This is not the installed desktop app
wrongLaunch.body: You opened the UI in a web browser or by double‑clicking an HTML file. The local SQLite database and sign‑in only work inside the packaged Electron application.
wrongLaunch.step1: Close this browser tab or window.
wrongLaunch.step2: From the Windows Start menu, search for “DentAssist Pro” and launch the real app shortcut.
wrongLaunch.step3: Do not open dist/index.html in a browser after building — that is not the program.
wrongLaunch.hint: When launched correctly you get a frameless desktop window (custom title bar) and login works with the seeded users.

electron.title: Desktop window opened, but the app bridge did not load
electron.body: This is Electron, but the preload script did not attach `window.dentassist`, so SQLite and sign‑in cannot run. Often this means an outdated install or broken packaged files.
electron.step1: Fully quit the app from the taskbar.
electron.step2: Uninstall from Windows Settings → Apps, then install again using the newest “DentAssist Pro Setup …exe” built from the latest project sources.
electron.step3: Do not run the UI from the dist folder or a localhost URL in a browser — use only the shortcut created by the installer.
electron.hint: If it still happens, rebuild the installer (`npm run dist`) and install that build.
